svg.aria-label: Christopher van Rooyen. Azure software engineer in Brisbane. By day I build MCP servers and wire agentic AI into enterprise systems on Azure and Databricks. After hours I experiment with AI for decompilation, build open source products and make mods for games. Brisbane, 8:03 pm: The sun set at 6:15 pm. Waxing crescent, up now. Below, 15,322 contributions in the past year drawn as a city with one column per day; the busiest day had 769.
